record.viewport: 1133 CSS px wide iPad landscape, dark mode
record.summary: The render follows the reference apart from the accepted deviations. One small difference remains: the Inbox rows sit slightly closer together than in the frame.

findings.reference_location: Inbox panel, the three rows under "NEEDS YOU 3", titles at about y 369, 427 and 485
findings.reference_shows: the rows are 58 px apart from one title to the next, and the panel is about 279 px tall (y 298 to 577)
findings.render_location: Inbox panel, the three rows under "NEEDS YOU 3", titles at about y 367, 423 and 479
findings.render_shows: the rows are 56 px apart (2 px less per row), and the panel is about 273 px tall (y 296 to 569)

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: There is no Chats panel. The space below Context drift is empty down to the tab bar.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: There are three one-line rows, the count is 3, and the line over the rows reads "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: The rows have no priority mark, so their text starts at the panel's left inset. The pills are the same.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.

Columns. The Inbox panel is over the Queue panel, where the frame draws them side by side: at 1133 px the page has the tablet layout (ViewportFrame), which has one column, as T10b's card grid follows the tablet layout too. No token gives a panel's least width.
accepted_deviations.note: Both panels are full width, so the times and pills sit at the right edge of the full-width panels.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
Panel gap. One panel over the other, they are 24 apart where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).

Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories is increment two's live slice, and Ideas is increment one's. So Ideas sits where the frame draws Architecture, and the frame's QA tab is not there.
Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/, so the purpose breaks its lines at other words. The live page shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The purpose is on one line in both pictures.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top. The back row with Quick chat, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than the frame's: the page starts 24 down, where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has. The tabs are where the frame draws them.
accepted_deviations.note: The back row and the picture are 4 px higher. The tab row is at the same y (about 192).

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab bar. At 1133 px the iPad in landscape is narrower than the desktop layout's 1232 (lib/viewport.ts), so it draws the tablet layout, as T10b does. The tab bar is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105): Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts and More. The frame draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.

limits: I compared the 1:1 top and bottom halves of each picture and did not open the full-size images on their own.
Positions are estimated from the pictures to about 1 to 2 px, so the 4 px shift in A11 and the 24 px gap in A7 were checked only approximately.
